svg.title: Relay Android home screen widgets
svg.desc: Promotional layout containing unmodified production Android RemoteViews renders: Work Time and Baby Time; a work timer with Interruption and End; a running interruption timer with Resume and End; and Baby 1, Baby 2, All babies. The widget controls show centered timer mode labels and time, the stronger yellow interruption color, and current default colors, and generic child labels. No personal home screen is shown.
svg.metadata: Source renders: /tmp/relay-widget-centered-previews-v3/default-idle-376x82.png; /tmp/relay-widget-centered-previews-v3/default-work-176x82.png; /tmp/relay-widget-centered-previews-v3/default-interrupted-176x82.png; /tmp/relay-widget-centered-previews-v3/picker-2-children-376x82.png. Captured from actual Relay RemoteViews on Android by the isolated isolated widgetcheck harness for Relay1.15.1. Widget images are embedded without pixel editing or recoloring. Canvas1170x2532. Fictional labels only.
